# THE RELEASE-REQUIRED JOB SET (the reviewer's item 35)
#
# This file is the EXACT set of the release-required job names — the
# machine-readable authority the CI evidence-gate verifies against. The
# evidence-gate asserts EXACT SET EQUALITY:
#
#     set(entries of this file) == set(release-gate.needs)
#
# — both directions, no subset tests. A job added to release-gate's
# needs: list MUST be added here, and an entry here that is not a
# release-gate dependency FAILS the gate (the policy cannot drift from
# the aggregate or from this file).
#
# The set is the release-gate aggregate's DIRECT dependency list: every
# job whose success a release requires. `sast` (CodeQL) is NOT listed:
# the ruleset requires the separately-recorded "CodeQL" check-run
# context in addition to release-gate (a check-run context, not a job
# dependency — see the MAIN-BRANCH PROTECTION block in ci.yml).
#
# Syntax: one job name per line (`[a-z0-9-]+`), `#` comments and blank
# lines ignored. The evidence-gate parses exactly this format.
